name: SDS
recent: SDS 近期完成一项重大土地收购，其全资子公司 London Bakery 以 1.017 亿令吉收购柔佛新山一幅永久地契土地，交易已于 8 月 28 日股东特别大会通过后生效。此外，公司持续进行股份回购，董事局成员亦有股份交易活动。
notable: 全资子公司 London Bakery 以 1.017 亿令吉收购柔佛新山一幅永久地契土地，交易已生效。
公司近期多次进行股份回购。
董事 Tan Kim Seng 和 Tan Kim Chai 在闭市期间进行了股份交易。
risks: 董事 Tan Kim Seng 通过 SDS Tan Properties 在闭市期间出售 663,000 股。
执行董事 Tan Kim Chai 在闭市期间进行股份交易（出售及收购各 663,000 股）。

SDS Group’s RM101.7m Johor Bahru land deal becomes unconditional
MTAG’s RM53.58m Johor Bahru land deal turns unconditional

recent_en: SDS recently completed a major land acquisition, with its wholly-owned subsidiary London Bakery acquiring a freehold land in Johor Bahru for RM101.7 million, which became unconditional after shareholder approval at an EGM on 28 August. The company also continued share buybacks, and there were share dealings by directors.
notable_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary London Bakery acquired a freehold land in Johor Bahru for RM101.7 million, and the transaction has become unconditional.
The company conducted multiple share buybacks recently.
Directors Tan Kim Seng and Tan Kim Chai traded shares during the closed period.
risks_en: Director Tan Kim Seng disposed of 663,000 shares via SDS Tan Properties during the closed period.
Executive Director Tan Kim Chai traded shares (disposed and acquired 663,000 shares each) during the closed period.
